name: Corgi
author: zyrre
description: Your Herdr coding agents in the Omarchy bar: their state, latest messages and commands, and plan usage, with prompt, merge, close, new agent and jump-to-pane. Needs Herdr and the Corgi Herdr plugin.

barWidget.description: A compact Corgi dashboard with grouped agents, activity, and pane focusing.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the widget rereads an expanded transcript, and restarts its reader if it stopped.

schema.label: Bar display
schema.description: Compact shows agent counts; Icon shows the Corgi mark with a subtle status underline.

schema.label: Corgi command
schema.description: The Corgi command. herdr plugin install zyrre/corgi puts corgi in ~/.local/bin; set a full path only for another build.

schema.label: Herdr socket
schema.description: Only needed for a named Herdr session: that session's socket. Empty uses the default session, ~/.config/herdr/herdr.sock.
